title: Fxwallet — Convert Currency
objective: Convert between euros and dollars as often as you like. End up with more value than you started with, using nothing but conversions.

verifier.condition: The wallet's total value, counted in USD, has grown by at least $2.00 from conversions alone.

weakness: Conversions are rounded up to the next cent in both directions with no fee and a one-cent minimum, so repeatedly converting small amounts back and forth increases the wallet's total value.
seededData: Account alice with a 100.00 EUR balance and no USD. In memory; reset with the instance.
hints: Convert a small amount and then convert the result back. Compare what you started with to what you ended with.
Look at how the results are rounded, and in whose favour, then think about the smallest amount you can convert.
Round-trip the smallest possible amount many times; script it, because each round trip only gains a little.
burpNotes: Intruder or a small script is the right tool here: the gain per conversion is tiny.
